method: Actual classic-script bundle loaded from local HTTP; synchronous api.step updates and real post-IK skeleton/mesh sampled at 30Hz. GPU renderer temporarily suppressed, requestAnimationFrame disabled to prevent races. No source/mesh/IK code replaced. All mesh vertices evaluated after each update.
limitations: Single player-01 LOD0 in this run; other identities and LODs require separate runs.

Bone sole marker is (0,-0.08,0); palm marker is an approximate (0,-0.07,0) from the wrist, not a measured hand surface. Actual mesh floor min separately scans every vertex and is the geometric penetration gate.
The stateful solver was integrated at 30Hz; other integration rates can follow different paths and require a separate run.

Logical Root orientation is recorded separately because heading handoff counter-rotates Hips; its actual decoded skin weights must be zero. Hips and all descendant world orientations, and every bone position including Root, remain gated.

First-step root velocity is descriptive. Separate broad engineering pop guards limit visible joint world angular speed to 30 rad/s and bone speed relative to authoritative root travel to 25 m/s; they catch abrupt advancing-pose jumps but do not establish natural motion, acceleration quality or physical collision.
No physical phone GPU or FPS evidence.
